defs.d: A female who performs on the stage or in films.
A female doer or "actor" (in a general sense).
A strip of material used for strengthening or coupling.
A long strip of material, color, etc, that is different from the surrounding area.
To fasten with a band.
To fasten an identifying band around the leg of (a bird).
A person or thing who enjoys special regard or favour.
defs.ex: The teacher's favourite always went first.

defs.d: A person who is preferred or trusted above all others.
To favour.
To bookmark.
Preferred or liked above all others (unless qualified).

defs.d: Belonging to a category whose members are all preferred or liked over nonmembers.
defs.ex: I just saw a movie with all my favourite actors in it.

defs.d: An institution which holds books and/or other forms of media for use by the public or qualified people often lending them out, as well as providing various other services for its users.
(by extension) Any institution that lends out its goods for use by the public or a community.
Expressing distance or motion.
Expressing separation.
A woolly ruminant of the genus Ovis.
A timid, shy person who is easily led by others.
Ready money; cash
To prepare; to make ready for action.
Prepared for immediate action or use.
defs.ex: The porridge is ready to serve.

defs.d: Inclined; apt to happen.
A solid, more or less rigid object of metal or wood with a uniform cross-section smaller than its length.
defs.ex: The window was protected by steel bars.

defs.d: A solid metal object with uniform (round, square, hexagonal, octagonal or rectangular) cross-section; in the US its smallest dimension is 1/4 inch or greater, a piece of thinner material being called a strip.
defs.ex: Ancient Sparta used iron bars instead of handy coins in more valuable alloy, to physically discourage the use of money.

defs.d: A sport in which two opposing teams of five players strive to put a ball through a hoop.
The particular kind of ball used in the sport of basketball.
The study of all life or living matter.
The living organisms of a particular region.
The lowest part of anything.

defs.d: Character, reliability, staying power, dignity, integrity or sound judgment.
defs.ex: lack bottom

defs.d: To furnish (something) with a bottom.
defs.ex: to bottom a chair

defs.d: To wind (like a ball of thread etc.).
The lowest or last place or position.
defs.ex: Those files should go on the bottom shelf.

defs.d: A termination or conclusion.
The last part of something.
A small quantity of liquid, just large enough to hold its own round shape via surface tension, especially one that falls from a source of liquid.
defs.ex: Put three drops of oil into the mixture.

defs.d: A very small quantity of liquid, or (by extension) of anything.
defs.ex: asked for just a drop more tea; she was thirsty and there wasn't a drop of water to be found

defs.d: To fall in droplets (of a liquid).
To drip (a liquid).

defs.d: Movement or advancement through a series of events, or points in time; development through time.
defs.ex: Testing for the new antidote is currently in progress.

defs.d: Specifically, advancement to a higher or more developed state; development, growth.
defs.ex: Science has made extraordinary progress in the last fifty years.

defs.d: The quality of being organized.
defs.ex: This painting shows little organization at first glance, but little by little the structure becomes clear.

defs.d: The way in which something is organized, such as a book or an article.
defs.ex: The organization of the book is as follows.

defs.d: An object or other creation (e.g. narrative work) from which all later copies and variations are derived
defs.ex: This manuscript is the original.

defs.d: A person with a unique and interesting personality and/or creative talent
defs.ex: You’re a real original.

defs.d: Relating to the origin or beginning; preceding all others
defs.ex: the original state of mankind;  the original laws of a country;  the original inventor of a process

defs.d: First in a series or copies/versions
defs.ex: The original manuscript contained spelling errors which were fixed in later versions.

defs.d: A person or animal who receives treatment from a doctor or other medically educated person.
(grammar) The noun or noun phrase that is semantically on the receiving end of a verb's action.
defs.ex: The subject of a passive verb is usually a patient.

defs.d: (of a person) Willing to wait if necessary; not losing one's temper while waiting.
defs.ex: Be patient: your friends will arrive in a few hours.

defs.d: Constant in pursuit or exertion; persevering; calmly diligent.
defs.ex: patient endeavour

Any disturbed state of the atmosphere, especially as affecting the earth's surface, and strongly implying destructive or unpleasant weather.
A violent agitation of human society; a civil, political, or domestic commotion; violent outbreak.

Human arm.

The fact of being easy, or easily done; absence of difficulty, simplicity.
